description: A synthesised bass drum: one oscillator whose frequency is bent on each hit, a square sub-oscillator under it, and a burst of pink noise for the beater click.

params.text: Sets the oscillator frequency, 60Hz at the centre of the knob and 5Hz for each step either side, so 35Hz at one end and 85Hz at the other.
Sets the decay time of the envelope that bends the oscillator frequency; the knob runs from -0.2 to 1.2 seconds and the value used is held between 0 and 2.2 seconds.
Sets the decay time of the envelope on the drum's level; the knob runs from -5 to 5 seconds and the value used is held between 0 and 2.2 seconds, so much of its travel does nothing.
Crossfades between the main oscillator at one end and the square sub-oscillator at the other.
Multiplies the whole voice by 0 to 10 before the output clips at ±5V, so the upper part of its travel drives the drum into distortion.
Sets the level of the pink noise burst that opens each hit, 0 to 2.5V before the drive is applied.
Chooses how far below the main oscillator the sub-oscillator runs: the same frequency, an octave down, or two octaves down.
Chooses a sine or a square wave for the main oscillator; the sub-oscillator is a square either way.

inputs.text: Starts a hit each time the voltage rises through 0.5V.
Adds to the PITCH knob at 5Hz per volt, with no clamp on the result.
Adds to the PITCH DECAY knob at 1 second per volt, with the total held between 0 and 2.2 seconds.
Adds to the AMP DECAY knob at 1 second per volt, with the total held between 0 and 2.2 seconds.

notes: the length of the gate changes nothing: each hit releases its two envelopes a fixed fraction of a second after the trigger, and the noise click is shorter again.
the pitch envelope is subtracted from the oscillator frequency rather than added, so the frequency dips at the start of a hit and climbs back to what PITCH sets.
